_doc: T-1302. EVERY TOOL check.sh GATES WITH --check, AND WHAT MEASURING IT FOUND. This file exists because no pattern over SOURCE can classify these tools, which was the finding rather than the assumption. Three ways a regex is wrong, each measured 2026-09-18: the original anchored pattern saw 0 of them because it only matched a tool reading argv directly; widening it bluntly saw 59 but 8 of those declare no write mode at all and matched a string in their PROSE; and a pattern that looks only for a DECLARED flag misses read_fergus_1839.py, which has no --build and WRITES BY DEFAULT when the argument is neither --check nor --self-test. Behaviour is the only honest test, so each row here is a measurement with a date, not a guess.

_placement.manifest: listed in tools/derived_manifest.json — rederive.mjs --run rebuilds it
_placement.pending: measured to reproduce; not yet placed in the manifest's dependency order. Ordering is its own measured pass: on #1452 three reconstruction stages OSCILLATED until they sat in the right slot, so 52 of these cannot be appended blind.
_placement.not_derivable: re-running it does not reproduce its committed output, or it cannot run — with the measurement that says so
_placement.not_a_writer: gated with --check and declares no write mode; recorded so the audit stops reporting it
